```powershell
# Minimal (≤ 10 lines) – last 24h, export full Application logs around first hit
$cn=$env:COMPUTERNAME; $log='Application'
$since=(Get-Date).AddDays(-1)
$pat="BPAExecutionServerProxy\.CallExecutionServer.*BPAExecutionServer/agent/messages/get\?sessionid=.*Expecting element 'root'.*Encountered 'None'"
$first = Get-WinEvent -ComputerName $cn -LogName $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
		 Where-Object { $_.TimeCreated -ge $since -and $_.Message -match $pat } |
		 Sort-Object TimeCreated | Select-Object -First 1
if(-not $first){ Write-Host "No match in last 24 hours on $cn." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }
$ws=$first.TimeCreated.AddMinutes(-10).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
$we=$first.TimeCreated.AddMinutes(1).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
$out=Join-Path (Get-Location) ("AppLogs_±10m_{0:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.evtx" -f $first.TimeCreated)
wevtutil epl $log $out "/q:*[System[TimeCreated[@SystemTime>='$ws' and @SystemTime<='$we']]]" /ow:true
"First occurrence: $($first.TimeCreated)  Provider=$($first.ProviderName)  EventID=$($first.Id)`nSaved: $out"
```
